hook: THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN YOU AND ME? YOU REACT. I DECIDE WHAT HAPPENS.

lines.text: Tell me, do you know the difference between an expert and a genius?
An expert has learned everything there is to know about a subject.
But a genius, a genius knows how to use that information to rewrite the rules entirely.
Most people use knowledge to fit into society.
They study to get a job, to make money, to be respected.
They're training to be better tools for someone else.
I was raised to be the hand that holds the tool.
I don't care about the history of the world or the beauty of science.
I only care about the leverage those things provide.
You think you're smart because you've memorized a few textbooks?
Real knowledge is knowing exactly which button to press to make a good person do something evil.
I don't need to be your friend to control you.
I just need to know what you're afraid of.
Information is the only currency that never loses its value.
And right now, I'm the richest person in the room.
From now on, I share my knowledge.
